transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, yeah… I guess I’ve just been a little more stressed than I’m used to. Since my sister and her baby moved back home, things at the house have been kind of crowded, and I’ve been more on edge and down than usual.

It’s not like I’m falling apart or anything—I’m still going to class and the shop—but I’ve been snapping over small stuff at home, and then I show up already drained. I missed a couple deadlines, and I backed out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn’t keep everything straight. I figured I should come in before it gets worse, if that makes sense.
Have you been enjoying the things you normally like to do, like going to class and working at the shop?

I mean… mostly, I think. Class is okay, and I still like being at the shop once I’m there. I guess I haven’t been as into it every day as I usually am, but I wouldn’t say I stopped enjoying things or anything. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you noticed any decrease in pleasure from activities you normally enjoy?

I don’t think so, not really. Like, maybe I’m a little less excited to start things sometimes, but once I’m actually in class or at work, I can still get into it. So I wouldn’t say I’ve lost pleasure in stuff… if that answers it right.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I think it’s been about a month now… basically since my sister and her baby moved back into the house. It hasn’t been forever or anything, but that’s when I started noticing it.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
Um… not that I’ve really noticed. My clothes fit the same, I think. I haven’t been tracking it or anything, but I don’t think there’s been a big change.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried about things lately?

Yeah… a little, I guess. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but since my sister and her baby moved back in, I’ve been more on edge at home. Like, I’ll worry about keeping up with class and the shop, and then I get there already kind of drained.

I’m still doing okay overall, I think, but I have missed a couple deadlines, and I backed out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn’t keep everything straight. Is that the kind of worry you mean?
Have you been feeling sad most of the day, nearly every day, since your sister and her baby moved back in?

I wouldn’t say sad most of the day nearly every day, exactly… I mean, I’ve been more down than usual since they moved back in, and more on edge. I snap over little stuff at home, which I don’t feel great about.

Then I show up to class or the shop already kind of drained. I’m still getting by, I think, but I have missed a couple deadlines and I backed out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn’t keep everything straight. Does that make sense?
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't find pleasure in them at all?

I don’t think so… not “at all,” anyway. I still like the things I usually like when I actually get to them. Maybe I’m less excited sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’ve stopped enjoying them. Is that what you mean?
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Guilty… not really, I don’t think. I mean, I feel bad sometimes if I’m not handling things perfectly or if I seem annoyed, but I wouldn’t say I’m sitting around feeling guilty all the time or anything. Is that okay to say?
Do you feel like you're in a low mood for most of the day?

Most of the day… I don’t think I’d put it that strongly. I’ve definitely been more down than usual since my sister and the baby moved back home, and kind of on edge, but it’s more like I get worn out and drained, especially before class or the shop.

I’m still getting through things, mostly. I’ve just missed a couple deadlines and had to back out of helping with the theater set because I couldn’t keep everything straight. I don’t know if that counts as low mood most of the day, though.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now feel completely uninterested in?

No, I don’t think there’s anything I’m completely uninterested in. I might put things off or not feel as into it right away, but when I actually do them, I still enjoy them. I don’t think it’s like I’ve lost interest altogether.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight since you started feeling this way?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, my clothes fit the same as far as I can tell. I haven’t really been tracking my weight or anything, but I haven’t noticed a big drop.
Would you say that your sister and her baby moving back home was a very stressful event for you?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound like I blame them or anything, because I know it’s been hard for my sister too. But yes, it has been pretty stressful for me.

Since they moved back in, I’ve just been more on edge and kind of down more than usual. I catch myself snapping over little things at home, which I don’t feel great about. Then I’ll show up to class or the shop already feeling drained. I’m still getting by, I think, but I’ve missed a couple deadlines and I backed out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn’t keep everything straight.
Do you feel like you have no interest at all in the things you normally do?

No, I wouldn’t say no interest at all. I still care about the stuff I normally do… I just sometimes don’t feel like starting it, if that makes sense. But once I’m actually doing it, it’s usually okay. I don’t think I’ve totally lost interest or anything.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking in energy lately?

Yeah… a bit, I guess. I don’t want to overstate it, but since my sister and the baby moved back in, I feel like I’m already drained before I even get to class or the shop. I’m still getting through things mostly, but it’s been harder to keep everything straight, and I’ve missed a couple deadlines. I even backed out of helping with the theater set, which I normally would’ve done.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things that might happen in the future?

I don’t think so… not often, anyway. I mean, I’ll think about stuff coming up, like whether I’m keeping up okay, but I wouldn’t say I’m constantly worrying about the future or anything. Is that what you mean?
Have you felt like your stress and mood issues have significantly interfered with your relationships or daily activities?

Some, yeah… I mean, I’m still going to class and work, so it’s not like everything’s fallen apart. But I have turned in a couple assignments late, which I don’t usually like to do. And I had to drop the community theater set project because I just couldn’t keep up with everything. So… I guess it has interfered a bit, if that makes sense.
Have your feelings of being down and on edge lasted for at least two weeks since your sister and her baby moved back home?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been about a month now, pretty much since my sister and the baby moved back into the house. I mean, it’s not every single second or anything, but it’s been going on since then.
Do you feel like you're in a low mood almost every day?

Most days, yeah… though I don’t know if I’d call it really low all the time. It’s more like since my sister and her baby moved back home, I’ve been kind of down and on edge more than usual. I’m still getting to class and the shop, but I show up already drained, and I’ve missed a couple deadlines. I even backed out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn’t keep everything straight.
Have your feelings of being down and on edge lasted for at least two weeks without any significant improvement?

Yeah… I guess it has. It’s been about a month now, since my sister and the baby moved back in. I keep thinking it’ll settle down, and some moments are better, but overall it hasn’t really gone back to normal yet, if that answers it.
